title: Most Beautiful Item for Each Query
summary: Given a list of items with prices and beauties, for each query, find the maximum beauty of an item whose price is less than or equal to the query price.
statement: Given a list of items with prices and beauties, for each query, find the maximum beauty of an item whose price is less than or equal to the query price. If no such item exists, return 0 for that query. Return an array of answers corresponding to each query.
constraints: Each item is [positive price, positive beauty], and both inputs are nonempty.
For each query return the greatest beauty among items priced at most that query, or zero when none qualify.
Answers must remain in the original query order.
hints: Sort items and queries so one forward scan can reuse all earlier eligible items.
Maintain the maximum beauty among item prices no greater than the current sorted query.
Sort (query,original_index); advance items while price<=query; store the running maximum at original_index.
The running maximum contains exactly the eligible prefix, and restoring indices preserves requested output order.
editorial: The running maximum contains exactly the eligible prefix, and restoring indices preserves requested output order.
